candidate_value.description: The first N-1 lines of each test case's output are the same cards as the input, but in the correct order, and the output path is a linear sequence where each card's destination matches the next card's origin.
candidate_value.expression: all(all(output_lines[k].split()[0] == output_lines[k+1].split()[1] for k in range(N-2)) and set(output_lines[:N-1]) == set(stdin.splitlines()[test_case_start:test_case_start + N - 1]) for test_case_start in [sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]) for i in range(1, T + 1)) + 1 for T in [int(stdin.splitlines()[0])]] for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[test_case_start - 1])] for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[test_case_start:test_case_start + N + 1]])

candidate_value.description: The output path is a valid topological ordering of the input cards, forming a single linear path with no cycles or disconnected components, covering all N cities exactly once.
candidate_value.expression: all(len(set(city for line in output_lines[:N-1] for city in line.split()[:2])) == N and all(output_lines[k].split()[0] == output_lines[k+1].split()[1] for k in range(N-2)) and len(set(line for line in output_lines[:N-1])) == N-1 for test_case_start in [sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]) for i in range(1, T + 1)) + 1 for T in [int(stdin.splitlines()[0])]] for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[test_case_start - 1])] for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[test_case_start:test_case_start + N + 1]])

candidate_value.description: The last line of each test case's output is the total cost of the journey, which is the sum of the costs of the ordered cards.
candidate_value.expression: all(output_lines[N] == str(sum(int(line.split()[2]) for line in output_lines[:N-1])) for test_case_start in [sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]) for i in range(1, T + 1)) + 1 for T in [int(stdin.splitlines()[0])]] for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[test_case_start - 1])] for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[test_case_start:test_case_start + N + 1]])
